f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.definition: 호텔에 도착한 뒤 방을 사용할 수 있게 되는 시점으로 보통 오후 2시나 3시부터입니다. 그 전에 짐을 맡기면 호텔에서 무료로 보관해 주는 경우가 많습니다.
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.gloss: 호텔에서 손님을 등록하고 방을 받는 시점.

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.definition: Momento em que o hóspede retira o quarto, normalmente a partir das 14h ou 15h. Antes disso, o hotel costuma guardar as malas do hóspede sem custo; em airports, o mesmo termo designa o procedimento de embarque.
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.gloss: A hora em que você toma possession do quarto no hotel, normalmente a partir das 14h ou 15h.

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.definition: Proses dan waktu saat tamuBreast check-in di hotel untuk mengambil kamar, umumnya mulai pukul 14.00 atau 15.00. Sebelum check-in, hotel biasanya menyimpan bagasi tamu secara gratis.
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.gloss: Waktu saat tamu resmi mengambil kamar hotel.

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.definition: ช่วงเวลาที่ผู้เข้าพักรับห้องและเริ่มเข้าพักตามเวลาที่โรงแรมกำหนด โดยปกติอยู่ระหว่าง 14:00 ถึง 15:00 และก่อนถึงเวลาดังกล่าวโรงแรมมักเก็บกระเป๋าให้ฟรี
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.gloss: การรับห้องพักและเริ่มเข้าพักตามเวลาที่โรงแรมกำหนด

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.definition: Odanın teslim alındığı zaman; genellikle saat 14.00 veya 15.00’dir. Otele erken gelenler çantalarını genellikle ücretsiz olarak otelde bırakabilir.
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.gloss: Otelde odaya giriş ve odayı teslim alma işlemi.

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.text: Check-in is from 14:00, but I can leave my bags with you in the morning.
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.translation: Giriş saat 14.00, ancak çantalarımı sabah otele bırakabilir miyim?

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.text: Check-in is from 14:00, but I can leave my bags with you in the morning.

f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.text: Check-in is from 14:00, but I can leave my bags with you in the morning.
f7fd941b6fe378afea16ab990e4f476f41df119c.translation: O check-in é a partir das 14h, mas posso deixar minhas malas com vocês pela manhã.
